mode.description: Whether this is an engagement (new visitor) or advocacy (returning user) session.

user_id.description: Identifier for returning users in advocacy mode.

user_display_name.description: Display name of the returning user, loaded from dashboard data.

avg_communication_score.description: Average communication score (1-5 scale) from the dashboard.

avg_critical_thinking_score.description: Average critical thinking score (1-5 scale) from the dashboard.

avg_mcq_score.description: Average MCQ score as a percentage from the dashboard.

passages_attempted.description: Total number of passages attempted by the user.

time_spent_minutes.description: Total time spent on the platform in minutes.

percentage_effort.description: Percentage of effort based on activity consistency.

streak_days.description: Number of consecutive days the user has practiced.

days_since_last_login.description: Number of days since the user last logged in.

visitor_context.description: What brought the visitor to BoostCTC or what they are looking for.

career_stage.type: enum: early | mid | senior | student | parent
career_stage.description: Where the visitor is in their career or learning journey.

interest_area.type: enum: ai_literacy | critical_thinking | communication | leadership | all
interest_area.description: Which skill area resonates most with the visitor.

resonance_point.description: The specific feature, story, or value proposition that resonated with the visitor.

reflection_response.description: The visitor's response to the Socratic reflection question.

engagement_signal.description: Whether the visitor showed interest in trying BoostCTC.

user_role.description: The visitor's professional role or primary interest area.

farewell_acknowledged.description: Whether the visitor acknowledged the closing message.

return_acknowledged.description: Whether the returning user acknowledged the welcome back.

self_assessment.description: The user's own assessment of their progress and performance.

identified_gap.type: enum: critical_thinking | communication | consistency | mcq_accuracy | overall
identified_gap.description: The skill gap the user wants to focus on improving.

nudge_accepted.description: Whether the user accepted the personalized recommendation.

next_action_commitment.description: What the user committed to doing next on the platform.
